project_type: Flutter HRMS app with BLoC state management and go_router navigation
build_system: Flutter SDK with pub dependencies - no explicit build scripts
verification_instructions: Run flutter analyze to check for compilation errors, then build/run the app to verify UI functionality and navigation flow
snapshot_or_generated_files: null - no generated files to check in
environment_constraints: Android requires API 36+ (compileSdk issue mentioned in original error logs)
contribution_requirements: Follow BLoC pattern for state management, use go_router for navigation with proper route guards, implement responsive UI (mobile <600px, tablet 600-1200px, desktop >1200px)
key_patterns: AttendanceScreen/AttendanceBloc pattern for screens and state management, EmployeeRepository pattern for mock data repositories, AppColors for consistent theming, permission-based routing guards, StatefulShellRoute.indexedStack for main navigation
directory_structure: lib/features/{feature}/data/ for repositories, lib/features/{feature}/domain/ for models, lib/features/{feature}/presentation/screens/ for UI screens, lib/features/{feature}/presentation/blocs/ for state management, lib/shared/ for common components and models, lib/core/ for router and theme
